name: Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce
author: Nilesh Kanzariya

sections.description:
Are you tired of clicking “Complete Order” hundreds of times?
Let’s fix that in 1 minute.

👉 Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce is the easiest way to automatically mark WooCommerce orders as Completed — with smart rules for product type, payment method, and user roles.

No coding. No headaches. Just set it and forget it.

Why Store Owners Love This Plugin ❤️

  • ⚡ Save Hours Every Week – Never waste time completing orders again
  • 🎯 Smart Rules – Auto-complete based on products, payment gateways, and customer roles
  • 💸 Boost Customer Experience – Deliver products instantly after payment
  • 🔒 Safe & Secure – Cash on Delivery & unpaid gateways excluded
  • 🌍 Works Everywhere – Compatible with PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo & more

Perfect for:
✅ Digital stores (courses, software, eBooks, music, videos)
✅ Subscription & membership sites
✅ Busy shop owners who value their time

💡 Imagine this: You’re asleep. A customer buys your product. It’s delivered instantly. No manual clicks. That’s freedom.

Free Features

Start saving time instantly with powerful features included in the free version:

🔹 Product Types
– ✅ Supports ALL product types together (Simple, Grouped, Variable, Virtual, Virtual + Downloadable).

🔹 Payment Methods
– ✅ Works with all major payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo, Square & more).
– ✅ Secure: Cash on Delivery, Check, and Bank Transfer are excluded by default.

🔹 Automation & Rules
– ✅ Auto-complete based on payment methods, and customer roles.
– ✅ Global toggle to enable/disable in one click.
– ✅ Safe & lightweight — optimized for stores with 10k+ orders.

🔹 User Role Management
– ✅ Admin & Customer roles supported by default.

🔹 Extra Features
– ✅ Thank You Page custom message.
– ✅ Show payment method on order details page.

Premium Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced automation and management tools:

🔹 Product Types
– ✅ Free: Works with all product types together (Simple, Grouped, Variable, Virtual, Virtual + Downloadable).
– ✅ Pro: Unlock rules to target specific advanced product types (Variable-only or Subscription-only).
– ✅ Apply autocomplete rules to specific products (product picker).

🔹 Payment Methods
– ✅ All Payment Methods Supported (Free & Pro)
– ✅ Payment Methods by Specific Region (Pro only)

🔹 Email Notifications
– ✅ Admin Email Notifications (Pro only)
– ✅ Customer Email Notifications (Pro only)

🔹 Advanced Features
– ✅ Thank You Page Message
– ✅ Show Payment Method on Order Page
– ✅ Custom Admin Orders Table (Pro only)
– ✅ Import/Export Settings (Pro only)

🔹 User Role Management
– ✅ Admin & Customer Roles (Free)
– ✅ All User Roles (Pro only)

👉 Unlock Pro to take your WooCommerce automation to the next level. Get advanced product rules, custom emails, and powerful admin tools.
Get Pro License

Documentation & Demo

📖 Documentation: https://nilsatwara.github.io/autocomplete-woocommerce-orders/
🖥️ Live Demo: Coming soon 🚀

Notes

Supported Gateways

✅ PayPal
✅ Stripe
✅ Square
✅ Apple Pay
✅ Google Pay
✅ Amazon Pay
✅ Klarna
✅ Afterpay
✅ Venmo
✅ All other gateways that confirm successful payment

Not Supported

❌ Cash on Delivery
❌ Check Payment
❌ Bank Transfer

(Excluded for security reasons — unpaid orders should not be auto-completed.)

Helpful Tips

  • Lightweight: won’t slow down your site
  • Works with all WooCommerce themes
  • Ideal for digital goods, courses, or memberships
  • Combine rules, e.g. auto-complete digital products via Stripe for logged-in users

Summary

Autocomplete Orders WooCommerce gives you full control over how and when WooCommerce orders are completed — saving you time and reducing errors.
With Pro features, you unlock advanced product types, region-based rules, notifications, and admin tools to scale your store.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/autocomplete-for-woo-orders/
  2. Activate under Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Smart Autocomplete
  4. Turn on rules (products, roles, gateways)
  5. Done ✅ Orders will auto-complete without you lifting a finger
sections.faq:
Does this plugin complete ALL WooCommerce orders automatically?

By default, it completes all paid orders (like Stripe, PayPal, etc.) for supported product types. In Free, it supports all product types together. In Pro, you can also choose specific product types like only Variable or only Subscription.

Will it work with Cash on Delivery (COD) or unpaid methods?

❌ No. COD, Check, and Bank Transfer are excluded for security reasons. These require manual approval.

Does it support subscription or membership products?

Yes ✅ — In the Pro version, you can apply autocomplete rules only for Subscription or only for Variable products. Free covers all product types together.

Will this affect WooCommerce emails (customer/admin notifications)?

No. WooCommerce emails still work normally. In Pro, you can enable additional admin and customer email notifications.

Can I auto-complete only specific products or categories?

Yes ✅ — In Free, you can pick individual products. In Pro, you can also target product categories and advanced product types.

Is this plugin safe for live stores?

Yes. It uses WooCommerce-native hooks. Orders are only completed if payment is confirmed by the gateway.

Will this slow down my site?

No. It’s lightweight and optimized — it only runs during checkout/order completion. Tested with stores processing 10,000+ orders.

Which payment gateways are supported?

All major gateways that mark payments as “complete”: PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo, Square, and more.
